reponse: Daniel Levi owns SAML end to end [3][1]. The Linear ticket lists November 27 as the internal due date, which leaves a buffer before the contractual go-live [1]. That go-live is December 1, 2026, and missing it triggers a 10% credit on the Q1 invoice [2]. The Notion design doc that lists the owner as TBD is from October 20, so it's outdated [4]. Production go-live may slip, since Fernhill's change board meets on November 26 and the production IdP metadata can't be exchanged before then [6].
